You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find 5 segments: straight runs of length>=2
    segs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(cs)>=2 and all(cs[i+1]==cs[i]+1 for i in range(len(cs)-1)):
            segs.append(('h',min(cs),max(cs),r))
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(rs)>=2 and all(rs[i+1]==rs[i]+1 for i in range(len(rs)-1)):
            segs.append(('v',min(rs),max(rs),c))
    allcells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=5]
    if not allcells: return out
    pc=[c for _,c in allcells]; pr=[r for r,_ in allcells]
    p0,p1,c0,c1=min(pr),max(pr),min(pc),max(pc)
    band_cells=sorted(allcells)
    for typ,a,b,line in segs:
        if typ=='v':  # vertical bar: extend horizontally over band's column span
            if not any(c==line for r,c in band_cells): continue
            lo,hi=min(c for r,c in band_cells if r==line),max(c for r,c in band_cells if r==line)
            band=[g[line+k][lo] for k in range(hi-lo)]
            blen=len(band)
            # fill rows spanning the bar (all rows of the line segment), cols from lo..hi extended periodically
            rows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][line]==5]
            for r in rows:
                for c in range(lo,hi):
                    out[r][c]=band[(c-lo)%blen]
        else:  # horizontal bar: extend vertically over band's row span
            if not any(r==line for r,c in band_cells): continue
            lo,hi=min(r for r,c in band_cells if c==line),max(r for r,c in band_cells if c==line)
            band=[g[lo+k][line] for k in range(hi-lo+1)]
            blen=len(band)
            cols=[c for c in range(w) if g[line][c]==5]
            for c in cols:
                for r in range(lo,hi):
                    out[r][c]=band[(r-lo)%blen]
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import json
def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    pat=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=5]
    segs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(cs)>=2 and all(cs[i+1]==cs[i]+1 for i in range(len(cs)-1)):
            segs.append(('h',min(cs),max(cs),r))
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][c]==5]
        if len(rs)>=2 and all(rs[i+1]==rs[i]+1 for i in range(len(rs)-1)):
            segs.append(('v',min(rs),max(rs),c))
    if not pat: return out
    pset={(r,c) for r,c,_ in pat}
    lo=min(r for r,c in pset); hi=max(r for r,c in pset)
    co=min(c for r,c in pset); ci=max(c for r,c in pset)
    # pick line segment closest to pattern
    best=min(segs, key=lambda s: sum(abs(r-s[3])+abs(c-s[2]) for r,c in pat))
    t,a,b,line=best
    if t=='v':  # vertical bar at col=line; extend horizontally over band's column span
        band=[[g[k][line] for k in range(lo,hi+1)] for r in range(co,ci+1)]
        blen=len(band[0])
        rows=[r for r in range(min(r for rr in [rr for rr,_ in pat]), max(r for _,cc in [(r,_) for r,_ in [(rr,_ ) for rr,_ in pat]])+1)]
        # actually fill rows covering band bbox rows + line extent: union of band rows and line rows
        linrows=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][line]==5]
        fills=set(range(lo,hi+1))|set(linrows)
        for r in fills:
            for c in range(co,ci+1):
                if g[r][c]!=5: out[r][c]=band[(r-lo)%len(band)][(c-co)%blen]
        for c in range(co,ci+1):
            for r in range(co,ci+1):
                pass
    else:  # horizontal bar; extend vertically
        band=[[g[line][k] for k in range(co,ci+1)] for r in range(lo,hi+1)]
        blen=len(band)
        lincols=[c for c in range(w) if g[line][c]==5]
        fills=set(range(lo,hi+1))|set(lincols)
        for c in fills:
            for r in range(lo,hi+1):
                if g[r][c]!=5: out[r][c]=band[(r-lo)%len(band)][(c-co)%blen]
    return out
